assets.name: background
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Edit this portrait cartoon forest background into a SIMPLER, CALMER version for a layered mobile camp game, maintaining its cheerful green palette and bold dark cartoon outlines. Most important change: create an obvious broad grassy LAWN CLEARING, a gently flattened open oval of light warm green grass across the middle/lower scene, from approximately 40% to 78% of image height. It is real level ground connected to the surrounding ground, NOT a floating island, rug, platform, circle UI or isolated disc. A large separately added boy will stand with boots at x39%, y66%; put a clear flat landing area there with no foliage. Simplify dramatically: two edge-framing trees made of broad smooth foliage masses, at most 3 leaf color regions per tree, no individual tiny leaves or bark hatching; distant forest as just 2–3 broad soft silhouettes; remove mountains and most tiny trees, stones, speckles, dirt streaks and dozens of grass tufts. Lawn should be mostly one flat green fill with a subtle edge and no grass texture. Only 3 or 4 small grass clumps at extreme edges, never center. Sky is a modest quiet opening, lower two-thirds dominated by grassy ground. Keep clean 2D ink outline and at most one flat shadow tone per shape, absolutely no watercolor texture or 3D rendering. Background only: no characters, tent, fire, kettle, pet, hammock, lamp, rug, furniture, UI, text, numbers, paths, trails. Same portrait aspect ratio as reference, full-bleed.

assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Image 1 is the object to edit, Image 2 is the NEW simplified style reference. Preserve the subject, silhouette, overall color, pose, orientation and identity from Image 1. Simplify its rendering just a little to harmonize with Image 2: clean bold dark outlines, large flat color fills, at most one broad shadow shape per material. Remove tiny scratches, stipple, hatching, texture, little white glints, multiple gradient bands, overly busy internal linework. Keep its friendly adventure-cartoon character. No new objects, no scene, no ground. One isolated object fully visible, genuine transparent background with alpha. NO colored halo, glow, matte, paper, checkerboard, cast shadow or text. Preserve this SAME blond boy, dot eyes, simple smile, cream tunic, blue trousers and pale boots. Keep the same full-body slim build and exact outfit; do not change body shape. Remove most fold lines and small highlights from hair, shirt and boots, keep only essential large folds. Frame full head and both boots with minimal transparent padding.
